{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a slightly dropped shoulder, deep emerald green (#0a3d25), lightweight woven fabric.
Tailored wool-trimmed blazer, structured single-breasted cut with peak lapels, forest green matching the blouse (#1e3f34), heavy mid-weight wool blend.
High-rise tailored trousers, straight-leg silhouette with a clean crease, charcoal grey (#2b2b2b), fine worsted wool with a subtle heather texture.
Classic pointed-toe pumps, moderate 3-inch heel height in a glossy finish, burgundy red (#641e16), smooth calfskin leather.
Delicate gold-fill necklace with small pendant, thin chain length to rest at collarbone, polished metal; structured handheld clutch in matching deep forest green velvet; sheer black silk scarf tied loosely at the neck.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an evening date at a restaurant by adhering to your requested "smart" dress code while leveraging the autumn season's warmth through natural wool and silk textures without feeling heavy. The coordinated deep emerald tones in your top and jacket create a cohesive, elegant silhouette that feels sophisticated yet approachable for a romantic setting. Choosing dark charcoal trousers grounds the brighter colors and adds a modern touch to the classic blazer-and-blouse combination, ensuring you look polished under artificial restaurant lighting."}
